div.head: Meeting with Laurent Romary
div.p: 20th May 2022: The Director of Scientific Culture and Information and TEI expert Laurent Romary is invited to Vienna to meet up with the WIBARAB members involved in the creation of the database, namely all the members of the ACDH-CH, the PI Stephan Prochazka and post-doc Ana Iriarte Diez accompanied by the master students. He advises the team on how to proceed with the buildup of the database using TEI and how to overcome conceptual and technical obstacles.
